predecessors.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
predecessors.text: Ronda, once 'the Córdoba caliphate broke up'

successors.name: Taifa of Seville
successors.text: the whole taifa, conquered by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid in 1065

ledger.x: 1039: the taifa of Ronda is established under the Berber Banu Ifran.
1065: the taifa of Ronda ends with Abbad II's conquest ('It existed from 1039 to 1065').

wars.name: Seville's conquest of the taifa of Ronda
wars.outcome: Seville under Abbad II al-Mu'tadid conquered Ronda in 1065 and held it until 1091.

certainty.note: A small Berber taifa around Ronda; the pages give no frontier.
